note: Claude Code plugins the kit installs with the person's own claude CLI when Claude is chosen. Each marketplace is fetched from its own repository at a pinned commit (the git commit is its content digest); nothing is vendored here. Plugins that connect to an account are installed only: each teammate signs in through the plugin's own flow, and the kit never writes a token or MCP credential. Excluded by the owner: claude-mem. Plugin files are pinned by git commit; MCP servers that run an npm package are version-pinned (each plugin's npm field records the version and registry integrity), and some MCP servers connect to vendor services at run time (see each plugin's runtime note).

marketplaces.name: cc-gemini-plugin
marketplaces.license: MIT (stated in its README; the repository has no LICENSE file)

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.license: Apache-2.0 (atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server); connects to your Atlassian account, sign in yourself
plugins.runtime: remote MCP server hosted by Atlassian; nothing of it runs locally

plugins.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
plugins.runtime: its MCP server runs `npx chrome-devtools-mcp@1.11.0`: version-pinned upstream, fetched from npm at launch

plugins.name: context7
plugins.license: Apache-2.0 (claude-plugins-official); its MCP server may ask for your own Context7 key, which the kit never writes
plugins.runtime: remote MCP server hosted by Context7; nothing of it runs locally

plugins.name: data-engineering
plugins.runtime: its hooks and tools run through uv/uvx, which fetch Python packages at run time

plugins.name: figma
plugins.license: no licence file in figma/mcp-server-guide; installed by reference from the official marketplace, nothing redistributed; connects to your Figma account, sign in yourself
plugins.runtime: remote MCP server hosted by Figma; nothing of it runs locally

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.runtime: its MCP server runs `npx @playwright/mcp@0.0.83`: the kit's playwright-mcp-version edit pins the upstream `@latest`, fetched from npm at launch

patches.description: Shorten the Codex Companion SessionEnd hook timeout from 5 to 3 seconds, as on the owner's setup.
